name: game-scope-check
description: > Checks scope against time and capacity: feature inventory, MoSCoW with effort caps, impact and risk scores, buffer math, scope-creep signals and a cut list, with velocity calibrated for AI-agent work and vibe debt counted as risk. Use for "scope creep", "can we fit this", "what should we cut", "are we on track". Not for sprint task planning (use game-sprint-plan).
author: AlterLab-IEU
